K1.text: Auth.js DB sessions are server-side revocable, but the adapter stores the session token raw and the magic link is consumed by GET callback; unchanged since baseline, no fix landed.

K2.text: No admin/owner role exists (single-practitioner users only; intake owner is an env-designated email, not a privileged role), so no privileged user to require MFA for.

K3.text: Full sweep of all 15 route handlers plus studio page: every private handler calls auth() and returns 401; /studio/* also gated in middleware; only 'use server' exports are sign-in/out in page.tsx; public exceptions are intake (keyed/limited), /s/[token] (capability) and worker (CRON bearer).

K4.text: Full sweep: use-cases by (id,userId), kickoff jobs via getOwnedJob/userId-scoped approve/feedback/exports, share-links joined to useCases.userId, kickoff POST scoped by caseId+userId; share page reads by token then link.useCaseId (capability, not caller scope).

K5.text: Rate limits are per-instance in-memory Maps in middleware and the intake route, not a shared store (SEC-03); sign-in has none.

K6.text: Share tokens are the raw primary key with no expiry column; revocable via revoked flag, allowlisted projection and no-referrer/noindex/no-store are in place (SEC-02).

K7.text: Security headers only set on /s/:token*; no global Referrer-Policy, nosniff, X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors or HSTS.

K8.text: INTAKE_KEY gate is skipped when unset (fails open) and compared with !== from the request body (SEC-01); CRON_SECRET fails closed but uses !== (SEC-04).

K9.text: No inbound webhooks; the only external callback is the Vercel cron worker.

K10.text: No tokens or bodies logged, but the intake notify email silently returns false when AUTH_RESEND_KEY is unset and there is no production fail-loud on missing provider.

K11.text: No schema-validated env at boot (db uses DATABASE_URL!), and .env.example omits INTAKE_KEY, INTAKE_OWNER_EMAIL, CRON_SECRET, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, KICKOFF_* (SEC-05).

K12.text: Integration tests and CI e2e run against a Neon branch, no code-level guard refusing cloud URLs; e2e does use build+start (production build) but on port 3000.

K13.text: No privileged/admin role or privileged-change surface exists; user-level CRUD and plan approvals only, so no privileged audit log applies.

K14.text: No ignoreCommand in vercel.json, port 3000 (collides with storage) not set in package.json (OPS-01), and cron worker compare is not constant-time (fails closed though).
